# Private cutoff transport for actual positive native children

Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance. Apache-2.0.
**No new kappa. All five selected global assumptions remain.**

## 1. Exact claim and source boundary

Canonical base is `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`. The immediate
source is the complete positive-child package at public commit
`12e58dfdad9371a26f9978c814779da344fd80b4`. Its 162 files are retained
unchanged with exact hashes and Git blobs. The lineage includes the current
positive leaf at `61edc4fe348f0aeadc82a3b642a802cbfb03aed8`, current monomial
at `7d1ff23714e6f9182c1d0ff9214f65def2f30e04`, literal header pattern at
`772198276518065c6ae42ef4bafc77df9c3c73b3`, and row dispatcher at
`5c59d247d51c6e1fca0dead3ed2139b6802b3a15`. Three additional unchanged
row-dispatch files are retained for read-only consumer provenance.

For any one of the 3453 actual selected positive PAID occurrences, the exact
typed source binder supplies its owner and fixed rank r, with 1<=r<=8.
Fix an admissible local nine-axis native parent and positive integers f,t,
where f is its column width and t its original encoded cutoff. The new
literal private view replaces exactly two values:

\[
                  (f,t)\longmapsto(rf,rt).
\]

All other 21 values, every complete numerical bit, the caller's parent,
source token and owner remain unchanged. The only numerical consumer of
the translated view is the exact unchanged positive leaf. Its existing
guard now accepts precisely when

\[
                     rf\le rt\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad f\le t.
\]

On that domain, with the same numerical prefix assumptions, the child acts
by positive C on the r selected coordinates in every one of the f columns,
preserving all spectators, rows and coefficient fields. It returns the
complete field and original parent, and retires all 388 fixed private ports.
The theorem applies to arbitrary positive f and t, not merely tested widths.

This replaces the earlier private f-only view's stronger condition rf<=t.
It does not change a source instruction's rank, waive a guard, or set the
parent cutoff to rt. Both products are built by literal paid tape operations,
and the unchanged leaf performs its original encoded comparison. Numerical
precision, exactness, full-field placement and source-to-machine premises
are retained. There is no complete MOVE or enclosing caller implementation
in this package.

## 2. Why this cutoff may be private, and why the public cutoff may not change

The audit is of the exact pinned consumer chain, not a claim about every
historical use of a variable named cutoff. The source inventory is recorded
in `SOURCE-AUDIT.json` and checked against the retained file identities.

| Pinned consumer | Use of encoded cutoff | Consequence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Header pattern `header_view.py` | Copies it with the unchanged 23-field schema | No local cutoff computation or decision |
| Current monomial and Compact adapters | Generic canonical header decoding and cleanup; no numerical use of cutoff | Parent remains the appropriate monomial descriptor |
| Positive `leaf_provider.Provider.prepare` | Requires positive cutoff and compares f<=cutoff | The only numerical dependency is admission |
| `CoefficientEngine.run_leaf` and axis kernel | Receive width, positions, record sizes and rows; receive no cutoff parameter | Same selected axes and numerical arithmetic after admission |
| `row_programs.compile_leaf(N)` | Requires t>=N, then chooses elementary iff f<=t | This is a global row decision and must keep the original header |
| Recursive `compile_prepare` and root variant | Require t>=N and current width>t before deriving geometry | Mutating public cutoff changes the recursive contract |
| `services.RowServices` / `EncodedLeaf` | Delegate to those literal tables; root and child descriptors remain distinct | No alternate hidden cutoff translator is supplied |
| Row padding and compiler routes | Retain the original descriptor/geometry conventions | Source delivery and padding remain separately priced premises |

`leaf_provider.py` reads all 23 encoded values into owned Counts. Cutoff is
used in the positivity list and in one comparison in `prepare`; it is not
returned from `prepare` and is not an argument of `run_leaf`. The latter
receives f,K,rho,h,coefficient multiplicity, row count and the actual axis
widths. Its loop count is f, not cutoff. Private inventory is constructed
before any descriptor is read. Cutoff is never used to allocate roles,
split rows, choose recursive children or enlarge a reserved numerical field.
Its encoded digits are nevertheless read, compared, stored and erased, and
the complete E-dependent bill charges them.

Thus two admitted leaf descriptors differing only in cutoff have the same
numerical operator and shape, though their metadata costs can differ. This
statement follows from actual data flow, not from assuming that a threshold
is always semantically irrelevant.

By contrast the row proof defines one global certified
t=max(N,floor(h^eta)), shared by descendants, and leaves its actual producer
as a separate G_root premise. The new view is not that global descriptor.
An actual `compile_leaf(145)` control returns recursive for f=146,t=145
and elementary if only the public cutoff is changed to290. Both are exact
canonical metadata tests, not claims that a full root producer emitted
those specimens. Scaling both fields preserves that comparison, but still
breaks the original native relation selected_axes=9f+remainder when r>1.
There is therefore no permission to send the private view to a monomial,
ordinary/root row service, padding routine or general native consumer.
The actual wrapper passes it only to the positive leaf and preserves the
original parent for every caller-side use.

Separate historical constants called `binding.cutoff` or `page.leaf_cutoff`
in the retained ordinary engine are compiled engine thresholds. They are
not this encoded field, are not modified here, and no ordinary runtime is
constructed or called by the positive child.

## 3. Geometry and numerical semantics are unchanged

Retain the predecessor's valid local parent domain. Let u=active_start,
z=back_start, a=within_bits. Require positive outer,rows,f,K,G,H, h>=2,
c>=1, 0<=rho<K, remainder e with 0<=e<9, and

\[
(f-1)G\le H,\quad 2H\le u,\quad u+9fK\le z,\quad z+H\le a,
\qquad selected\_axes=9f+e\le d.
\]

The complete physical record size is b=6c(h+1), each complete row has
2^a records, row_bits=2^a b, and V=outer*rows*2^a b. The common component
quantum, all delimiters and the complete numerical frontier are unchanged.
Genuine physical disjointness, origin markers, initially blank private
bodies and the numerical provider's valid returned extent are premises.
Object-identity guards do not prove disjointness of arbitrary port wrappers.

The new view has exactly the same changed width rf as the predecessor's
rank view. Its axes are u+kK+rho for 0<=k<rf. Writing k=if+j identifies
them with the source coordinates u+(if+j)K+rho for i<r,j<f. Since r<=8<9,
the parent gives u+rfK<=a. All row/record/fibre arguments are identical to
the already proved rank view; multiplying cutoff changes none of them.

The positive matrix remains

\[
C=\frac12\begin{pmatrix}1+i&1-i\\1-i&1+i\end{pmatrix}.
\]

The unchanged engine applies C on these rf axes and identity on every other
coordinate. All exact half-normalization and absolute phases are retained.
This package does not repeat the predecessor's 2886-chart Clifford proof;
it authenticates that source binding and changes only its private threshold
delivery. Every intermediate Gaussian half must still lie on the common
grid and every component must fit the inherited signed kernel. The
predecessor's sufficient 2^(rf) divisibility/strict headroom envelope is
unchanged. Changing cutoff supplies no missing precision or margin.

The entire original input remains protected by the unchanged positive leaf
until successful export. Named valid-return parity/headroom/cutoff failures
retain that contract. The translated header is released in a `finally`
block, including after the leaf rejects. Malformed input, physical
interruption or a violating provider remains outside the theorem.

## 4. Literal arithmetic and exact header growth

The new table uses the same 39 private metadata roles, the original borrowed
parent port, and the unchanged Builder interpreter. It checks positive
canonical f and t. For each of those two fixed fields it multiplies the
decoded digits by the fixed source rank r into the blank VIEW role, clears
the old private field, copies the product back and clears VIEW. It then
encodes all 23 fields into VIEW and clears every decoded field. The loop
over two field names and the carry-state compilation depend only on the
fixed source, not on runtime values.

For a digit x and carry c, the multiplier writes (rx+c) mod2 and carries
floor((rx+c)/2). Starting with c=0, induction gives 0<=c<r and the exact
processed binary prefix. The final carry uses at most ceil(log2 r) bits.
Only read/write/unit-move/finite-goto instructions execute at runtime. The
parent is never a destination of a write, and every produced head returns
to its origin before borrowing. Release is the exact unchanged literal
cleanup program from the predecessor.

For positive x, let ell(x) be its binary digit length and b_r=ceil(log2 r).
Then ell(rx)<=ell(x)+b_r. The raw physical header encodes each integer as
1^ell 0 followed by ell binary digits, so E=2 sum ell_i+23. Consequently

\[
E'=E+2(\ell(rf)-\ell(f))+2(\ell(rt)-\ell(t))
   \le E+4b_r\le E+12.
\]

This counts both unary-length prefixes, both digit strings and unchanged
delimiters. These are raw binary header cells, not three-bit numeric record
symbols. Private decoded Counts in the numerical leaf use their inherited
codec, whose factor is already in the E-dependent leaf cost.

## 5. Complete cost, inventory and historical backing

The original row Builder bounds are retained: decoding costs at most
27E+1064 local instructions, encoding at most21E'+788, positive canonical
check at most20n+20, clearing at most7n+11, copying at most11n+12, and
multiplication by fixed r<=8 at most31n+53. The latter is no larger than
the retained multiplier-by-nine estimate: the runtime per-digit path is
the same and its final carry is shorter. Adding the two products, all
checks/copies/clears, boundary checks, encoding and final release gives,
conservatively, at most **2000E+20000 local instructions** on a valid
returned call. Each physical action is one of those instructions. This
loose ceiling includes complete creation, source restoration and erasure;
it is not an empirical fit.

Let T_C(V,h,rf,E') be the complete unchanged current positive-leaf invoice.
The new successful service costs

\[
F_{template}+T_C(V,h,rf,E')+O_r(E+1)
 = F_{template}+O\bigl(rfV+(E+13)^4+388\bigr).
\]

Here F_template includes source authentication/binding, fixed recipe/table
construction and fixed bank reservation. T_C includes all source access,
full numerical import/export, original-field protection, normalization,
axis routing, return and cleanup. On a named failure all executed work and
metadata cleanup remain charged. There is no free descriptor rewrite or
extra unpriced leaf. The original source field is delivered through the
same actual owner and exact typed PAID token; caller delivery and any
enclosing frame/row/ownership work remain outside this local interface and
cannot be dropped from a composed invoice.

The numerical cohort still has349 ports and the metadata cohort39, for
exactly388 fixed private roles. No row, stock, width budget, full reserved
extent or numerical packet is enlarged by threshold translation. Both
changed values occupy the already allocated private metadata bank. The
leaf's original number of encoded temporary roles is unchanged.

Each metadata role's current body/frontier extent is conservatively at most
2E+25, covering E'<=E+12 and all transient decoded products/guides. Across
many calls use max(B_initial,2 max(E)+25) for each role, where B_initial
includes any preexisting erased body history, add its supplied origin prefix,
and then sum the39 roles. Retain the complete inherited numerical backing,
caller fields/headers, parked ancestors and template storage. Erasure never
deallocates old backing, and distinct roles may reach their maxima on
different calls. Long-then-short tests measure actual visited cells for the
sparse metadata tapes; array numerical extents are separately labelled as
materialized storage. They are not silently equated with visited backing.

If an actual caller separately proves f<=t and t=max(N,floor(h^eta)), then
rf<=8t and this local numerical term is at most a fixed-rank multiple of
V(N+h^eta). That elementary arithmetic implication does not prove the
global cutoff producer, the descriptor/precision laws, helper stocks,
nonleaf supplier tariff, or any complete multiplication exponent.

## 6. Evidence and remaining obligations

The registered bounded gates execute every rank's literal table, independent
complete-header oracles, long f/cutoff cases and shrinking-history reuse;
reject zero widths/cutoffs and source-rank/alias/grant errors; and execute
the actual public row branch mutation control. The old f-only table is a
negative control and fails the new complete two-field oracle. Very long
metadata specimens test canonical arithmetic only; their other fields are
not claimed to form a globally produced numeric descriptor.

One bounded actual source event9934, owner76, rank2 executes all4096 records
with parent f=t=1 and private f'=t'=2. The old rank view rejects this same
local threshold, while the new service returns the predecessor's independently
derived Gaussian-character result, full parent and all388 blank work ports.
It completed in73.691 seconds under120 seconds with481525381 literal actions.
It is a local descriptor witness, not a global t>=145 producer witness,
a complete MOVE replay, a test of the stronger uniform divisibility envelope,
or an asymptotic timing result. Raw bytes and the complete receipt are retained.

The next useful steps are an exact caller installation retaining the original
global row descriptor, proof of that caller's f<=t and numerical/stock domain,
and the inherited literal numerical source-to-machine implication. The
parent global threshold must remain unchanged. All five foundational
assumptions and the complete conditional multiplication bound remain open
at their existing scope.
